headline: Australian Annual Inflation Rises to Three-Year High of 4.9% in October
summary: Australia's annual consumer price inflation accelerated to a three-year high of 4.9 percent in October, up from 4.3 percent in September, according to the Australian Bureau of Statistics.
why: Inflation metrics are critical inputs for the Reserve Bank of Australia when determining domestic monetary policy and interest rate paths.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: Higher inflation readings increase pressure on the central bank to maintain or raise interest rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An acceleration in consumer price inflation to a three-year high raised concerns over tighter monetary policy conditions.
